pathPolicy.reasonRecordIdIsRequired: The full catalog contains duplicate title groups and same-category version clusters. Record IDs prevent URL collisions.
pathPolicy.originalFileExtensionPolicy: Original source files may remain named .hdwav.wav in storage, while clean public audioSrc values can end in .wav through metadata mapping or future edge routing.

hardRules: Do not commit full audio to Git.
Do not use public/audio/rks3 as the full catalog host.
Do not rename source files during external storage migration.
Do not delete source files during storage migration.
Do not build clean public URLs without record IDs.
Do not promote full catalog paths until a 5-to-10-file pilot is tested.
Keep current live 30-record sample protected until external playback is proven.

implementationPhases.title: Approve canonical path shape
implementationPhases.action: Use category plus record ID plus slug so duplicate titles cannot collide.

implementationPhases.title: Create external media domain
implementationPhases.action: Reserve media.rks3.com for audio delivery through the chosen storage/CDN provider.

implementationPhases.title: Upload pilot only
implementationPhases.action: Upload 5 to 10 HDWAV files using storage object keys that preserve original filenames.

implementationPhases.title: Generate pilot metadata
implementationPhases.action: Create a pilot catalog that points audioSrc to external media URLs without touching the live portal.

implementationPhases.title: Test playback
implementationPhases.action: Confirm desktop, mobile, Safari, Chrome, seeking, range requests, caching, and load speed.

implementationPhases.title: Scale after approval
implementationPhases.action: Only promote full catalog external audioSrc values after metadata, visibility, and storage decisions are locked.
